description: GREENSBORO – Today, Michael Whatley welcomed hard-working North Carolinians and job creators to a roundtable in Greensboro focused on the No Tax on Overtime provision of the Working Families Tax Cut Act. Overtime workers and other job creators discussed how No Tax on Overtime has helped working families across the state keep more of what they earn and make ends meet.

title: Michael Whatley Hosts No Tax on Overtime Roundtable in Greensboro – Michael Whatley for Senate
